blocks.html: Chooks-to-Go, the well-loved brand that has become popular among Filipino chicken lovers with its unique tagline “Masarap Kahit Walang Sauce!” opened its first dine-in restaurant in the Philippines at Robinsons Place, Lipa last November 25, 2021.
“We are very pleased with our new found partnership with Robinsons Malls and we look forward to opening more dine-in outlets post- pandemic,” says Chooks-to-Go President, Ronald Mascariñas
“Finally, after more than a decade of bringing Chooks-to-Go oven-roasted chicken and a lot more to every Filipino household, you can now CHOOKS-TO-STAY!”

“We are all excited to welcome Chooks! to everyone’s favorite place not just for dining but also shopping and leisure experiences,” says Cathy Alejandro, Robinsons Malls Operations Director for Luzon.
